text: Sorry to bother you, this may well be a daft question. I'm minding my granddaughter, she's 5 months old, and her temperature has come up to 38.3 this evening. Earlier on she bumped her head on the edge of the coffee table while my wife was holding her. She cried straight away, a proper loud cry, and after a cuddle she settled and she's been completely her normal self since, babbling and grabbing at my glasses like always. The bit that gave me a fright was about half an hour ago she went all floppy lying on the sofa and I thought oh no. But she'd just had a very long day, out at the shops and visitors round, and she's worn out. When I picked her up she woke straight away, easy as anything, and started her usual cooing and smiling at me. So I think she's just tired. My daughter's away overnight and I didn't want to ring her and worry her over nothing. Is the temperature something to keep an eye on with the head bump, or am I fussing over nothing? I'm not sure what's normal at this age anymore, it's been a long time since mine were small.
